basic_details.scholarship_name: Universiti Putra Malaysia (UPM) Graduate Research Fellowship (GRF) & Special Scholarship Scheme
basic_details.offering_entity: Universiti Putra Malaysia (UPM) School of Graduate Studies (SGS)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Universiti Putra Malaysia Main Campus (Serdang, Selangor, Malaysia)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Faculty of Engineering, Faculty of Science, Faculty of Computer Science and Information Technology, Faculty of Agriculture, Faculty of Biotechnology and Biomolecular Sciences, and Institute of Bioscience.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~100 to 150 Graduate Research Fellowships awarded annually across faculties
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open internationally; typically 15 to 25 Pakistani agriculture, biotechnology, and computing researchers appointed annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 24 months for Master's by research; up to 36 months for PhD
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: Monthly research stipend: RM 1,800 to RM 2,300 / month for PhD (~PKR 117,000 to 149,500 / month); RM 1,300 to RM 1,600 / month for Master's (~PKR 84,500 to 104,000 / month) plus up to 100% full tuition fee waiver

nationality_requirements: Open to Malaysian citizens and international candidates of all nationalities (Pakistan fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Maximum 35 years for Master's; maximum 40 years for PhD candidates at the time of appointment.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized Bachelor's degree with minimum CGPA 3.00/4.00 for Master's; recognized Master's degree with minimum CGPA 3.00/4.00 for PhD from an HEC-recognized university.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.00 / 4.00; competitive applicants typically hold CGPA >= 3.40 / 4.00 with laboratory, computing, or agricultural research experience.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Agriculture, biotechnology, food science, environmental sciences, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer science, or bioinformatics.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or final-semester students expecting degree completion before semester commencement.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior scientific publications in Scopus/WoS indexed journals or agricultural/biotech laboratory experience advantageous.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.0, TOEFL iBT minimum 80, MUET Band 4.0, or recognized English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from an accredited degree-granting institution.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Malay language proficiency is not required.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open equally to all qualified applicants.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates must secure endorsement and laboratory placement from an active UPM principal investigator holding research grant funding.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold any concurrent national scholarship, industrial sponsorship, or full-time paid employment.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full or partial tuition fee waiver covered under the UPM Graduate Research Fellowship scheme.
tuition_fee.amount: 100% covered (~RM 12,000 to 18,000 / year value; ~PKR 780,000 to 1,170,000 / year)

admission_application_fee.details: UPM international postgraduate application fee of RM 250 paid during online portal submission.

accommodation.details: On-campus international graduate residential colleges at Serdang campus (approx. RM 250 to 450 / month), paid easily from living stipend.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly research assistantship stipend: RM 1,800 to RM 2,300 / month for PhD (~PKR 117,000 to 149,500 / month); RM 1,300 to RM 1,600 / month for Master's (~PKR 84,500 to 104,000 / month).

airfare.details: International travel between Pakistan and Kuala Lumpur is self-funded.

visa_fee.details: EMGS visa processing and Malaysian Student Pass fees paid by candidate.
visa_fee.amount: Approx. RM 2,000 to 2,500 borne by student

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive Malaysian student medical and hospitalization insurance provided via EMGS student pass package.

food_allowance.details: Campus cafeterias across Serdang campus provide affordable dining; daily meals cost approximately RM 15 to 25.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Access to UPM Sultan Abdul Samad Library, experimental farm stations, advanced analytical genomics labs, and greenhouses.
books_and_materials_allowance.amount: 100% covered agricultural and biotech research access

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Conference attendance and publication charges (APC) for high-impact Scopus/WoS indexed journals funded directly from host supervisor grant.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Grant-funded conference travel and APC charges

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free UPM campus shuttle bus network serving all residential colleges, academic faculties, and Serdang MRT/KTM stations.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single Malaysia premier research university in agriculture and life sciences (Universiti Putra Malaysia - UPM).
participating_institutions: Universiti Putra Malaysia Main Campus (Serdang, Selangor, Malaysia)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS World University Rankings #148 globally, Top 30 in Asia, World Top 50 in Agriculture & Forestry; Malaysia's premier research university in life sciences and biotechnology.
available_majors: Master of Science / PhD in Biotechnology
Master of Science / PhD in Agricultural Sciences
Master of Science / PhD in Food Science and Technology
Master of Science / PhD in Computer Science
Master of Science / PhD in Chemical Engineering
Master of Science / PhD in Environmental Studies
Master of Science / PhD in Biomedical Sciences
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Master's by Research: 1.5 to 2 years; PhD: 3 to 4 years
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's / Master's degree in relevant discipline with CGPA 3.00+, academic transcripts, research proposal, supervisor endorsement form, two reference letters, and IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL 80 or MOI certificate.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Faculty of Biotechnology and Faculty of Agriculture are premier centers; establishing prior supervisor connection is essential.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Focus research proposals on plant genomics, food security, smart agriculture (IoT/AI in farming), or bioprocess engineering where UPM holds massive government funding.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: UPM School of Graduate Studies (SGS) Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Contact prospective supervisor, obtain acceptance form, register on UPM postgraduate portal, submit application, upload credentials, and pay RM 250 fee.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Explore UPM faculty expertise directory and email prospective supervisors with CV and research draft.
Step 2: Obtain signed UPM Supervisor Acceptance and GRF Recommendation Form.
Step 3: Register on UPM SGS portal and submit online postgraduate application.
Step 4: Upload attested academic transcripts, research proposal, passport copy, and English proof.
Step 5: Faculty Graduate Committee reviews technical proposal and conducts online interview.
Step 6: SGS issues official Letter of Offer and GRF Fellowship Award Letter.
Step 7: Apply for EMGS Visa Approval Letter (VAL) and Single Entry Visa at Malaysian High Commission in Islamabad.
Step 8: Travel to Serdang, complete medical screening, and matriculate.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated departmental route: Application for admission and GRF award are reviewed together upon faculty recommendation.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Uploaded directly by candidate as signed PDF recommendation letters on official university letterheads.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of research intent detailing technical competencies, research goals, and synergy with host supervisor's funded research project.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: 5 to 8 page structured research proposal covering problem statement, literature review, methodology, equipment needs, and milestone schedule.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing qualifications, laboratory/field experience, software proficiencies, and publications list.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online technical interview via Google Meet or MS Teams conducted by prospective supervisor and departmental postgraduate coordinator.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS 6.0+, TOEFL 80+, MUET Band 4.0, or English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate accepted.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Notarized copies of degrees and transcripts; HEC and MoFA attestations required for Pakistani credentials during EMGS processing.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations for all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via UPM School of Graduate Studies portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official Bachelor's / Master's degree certificates and complete semester transcripts with CGPA >= 3.00.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by HEC and MoFA Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Structured research proposal (5-8 pages) aligned with supervisor's research grant objectives.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Scholarly proposal formatted with standard citations.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official UPM form signed by prospective supervisor confirming laboratory placement and willingness to supervise.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Obtained directly from UPM faculty supervisor.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Confidential evaluation letters from previous university professors or department heads.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: On institutional letterhead with official stamps.

required_documents_checklist.specification: IELTS 6.0+, TOEFL iBT 80+, MUET Band 4.0, or official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: MOI certificate from previous university accepted.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Full clear color scan of passport bio-data page valid for at least 18 months.

important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: June 30 (Semester I - October) / November 30 (Semester II - March)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Bi-annual intake cycles: Semester I in October and Semester II in March.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Prior CGPA, academic performance, and foundational coursework)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Prior publications, technical proposal rigor, and supervisor grant synergy)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 5% (Clarity of purpose and dedication to research)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 10% (Technical interview performance with prospective supervisor and faculty panel)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Faculty Postgraduate Committee, Dean of School of Graduate Studies, and Host Research Project PI.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-stage evaluation: departmental technical vetting followed by central SGS award confirmation.

competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~15.0% to 19.0% for applicants with pre-secured supervisor endorsement and CGPA >= 3.30
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: Undergraduate/Master's CGPA >= 3.30 / 4.00, coupled with prior lab project experience or publications
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates in biotechnology, agriculture, engineering, or computing with clear research plan and supervisor endorsement.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from Pakistani institutions (University of Agriculture Faisalabad, NUST, Quaid-i-Azam, COMSATS, UET Lahore, PMAS Arid Agriculture).
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Malaysia, Pakistan, Indonesia, Nigeria, Iran, Bangladesh, Egypt.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through official portal sgs.upm.edu.my.
Do not pay money to educational agents promising guaranteed fellowships; awards depend entirely on faculty supervisor endorsement.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: University application fee is RM 250 paid directly to UPM via secure online payment.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Commercial agent proposals are flagged and rejected; applicants must write their own technical research proposal.
hidden_costs_breakdown: EMGS visa approval and student pass fees: ~RM 2,200 to 2,500 (~PKR 143,000 to 162,500).
HEC and MoFA document attestations in Pakistan: ~PKR 15,000 to 25,000.
One-way flight to Kuala Lumpur: ~PKR 90,000 to 130,000.
Initial living deposit before first stipend cycle: ~RM 1,000 (~PKR 65,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: Scheme covers international flights. Reality: International travel and EMGS visa fees are self-funded.
Myth: You can apply without contacting a supervisor. Reality: Supervisor endorsement is effectively mandatory for GRF approval.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial portals claim scheme is purely a fee discount; in reality, GRF includes both full tuition waiver and monthly living stipend.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Maintain minimum CGPA 3.00 and Satisfactory (TM) research progress evaluation every semester.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research presence at UPM Serdang campus; scholars may be assigned up to 6 hours/week of laboratory or tutorial teaching assistance.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semi-annual progress report evaluated by supervisor and presented to Faculty Postgraduate Committee.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Recipients are barred from taking full-time outside employment; internal paid tutoring or research assistance is permitted within university limits.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; scholars are free to seek international careers, postdoc opportunities, or industrial employment in Malaysia or abroad upon graduation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero national service bond; recipients must meet graduation publication requirements (minimum 1-2 Scopus/WoS indexed papers) affiliated with UPM.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Termination of monthly stipend and withdrawal of fee waiver if research progress is evaluated as Unsatisfactory across consecutive reviews.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Non-transferable; scheme is funded internally by UPM.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Field of research cannot be changed without written permission from faculty dean and SGS.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Extensions beyond maximum tenure (24 months Master's, 36 months PhD) require special approval and are generally self-funded.
